title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court concerning the Request for Instructions on Raising Litigation Fee Collection Standards from the Jiangsu High People's Court
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Reply to the Request of the Jiangsu High People's Court on Raising the Standards for Litigation Fees

Fa [2003] No. 136

Jiangsu High People's Court:

We have received your Request on Raising the Standards for Litigation Fees (Su Gao Fa [2003] No. 241). Upon study, we hereby reply as follows:

1. In accordance with the central government's deployment to advance judicial system reform, the Supreme People's Court has begun a comprehensive revision of the Measures for Litigation Fee Collection by People's Courts. At present, it is not appropriate to amend individual standards within the Measures separately. The issues raised in your request will be considered together during the revision of the Measures.

2. Before the new Measures for Litigation Fee Collection are promulgated, people's courts at all levels must strictly follow the standards prescribed in the current Measures for Litigation Fee Collection when collecting litigation fees. No unit or individual may arbitrarily raise the fee standards or expand the scope of fees.

This is our reply.

August 6, 2003
